summary: The Acura Legend was a mid-size luxury/executive car made by Honda and sold under its Acura brand from 1985 to 1995 in the U.S., Canada, and parts of China. It came as a sedan, classified as full-size, and a coupe, classified as mid-size. It was Acura's first flagship sedan until it was renamed the Acura 3.5RL in 1996, the North American version of the KA9 series Honda Legend.
one_line: The Acura Legend was Honda's luxury mid-size car sold under the Acura brand from 1985 to 1995, later renamed the 3.5RL.
key_facts: The Acura Legend is a mid-size luxury/executive car manufactured by Honda.
The Acura Legend was sold under Honda's luxury brand, Acura, from 1985 to 1995.
The Acura Legend was sold in the U.S., Canada, and parts of China.
The Acura Legend was offered as a sedan, which was classified as a full-size car.
The Acura Legend was offered as a coupe, which was classified as a mid-size car.
The Legend coupe's classification is similar to how the Honda Accord is set up today, according to the note.
The Acura Legend was the first flagship sedan sold under the Acura nameplate.
The Acura Legend was renamed in 1996 as the Acura 3.5RL.
The Acura 3.5RL was the North American version of the KA9 series Honda Legend.
